title: CG 97 05r 01 cassava (Rajah 3): Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaTitle: CG 97 05r 01 cassava: Yield, Maturity and Characteristics
metaDescription: CG 97 05r 01 cassava is a cassava variety. About 10 months to harvest, 37 t/ha in trials. See its pest ratings and traits.
excerpt: CG 97 05r 01 is a registered cassava variety, also sold or known as Rajah 3. It was registered with the National Seed Industry Council in 2006 as NSIC 2006 Cv 39. It takes about 10 months from planting to harvest, with 37 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials.

blocks.text: How long does it take, and how much does it yield?

CG 97 05r 01 cassava takes about 10 months from planting to harvest. That is 0.5 months faster than the average of the 42 cassava varieties with a day count, 10.5 months. Count the months from planting, and plan the harvest for a dry stretch when you can.

Its average yield of 37 t/ha beats the average of its group, 33.84. Trial yields come from well managed plots, so your own will depend on water, fertilizer, pests and timing.

Once you know the day count, anee.io dates every task from each lot's own planting day, with [the growth stages and weather](/features/growth-stages-and-weather) beside it.

blocks.text: It showed no weak spot in the ratings on record. Still, a resistant variety can break down when a new strain or pest population comes, so keep scouting.

The pests and diseases that hit cassava fields most often: [whitefly](/pests/whitefly), [anthracnose](/diseases/anthracnose), [Cercospora leaf spot](/diseases/cercospora-leaf-spot), [mealybug](/pests/mealybug). Our [pest finder](/pests) and [disease finder](/diseases) help you name what you see.

Its roots have white flesh and light brown skin. Dry matter is 37.2 percent. A higher dry matter cooks mealy and gives processors more flour or starch from each tonne. The starch content is 23.7 percent. Its cyanide level, the HCN content, is low. A low level is safer for the table, while a high level calls for peeling, soaking and full cooking. It is recommended ideal as a table variety and also be used as feeds and starch source.
Where and when to plant CG 97 05r 01 cassava

It is recommended for anywhere in the country. Pick by buyer first. Starch and feed plants pay for yield and starch content, while the table wants a sweet, low cyanide variety that boils soft. A high starch variety needs a buyer within a day of harvest, because the roots spoil fast.

items.q: Is Rajah 3 the same as CG 97 05r 01?
items.a: Yes. Rajah 3 is another name for CG 97 05r 01, registered as NSIC 2006 Cv 39. Seed sellers use both, so ask for either one.

items.q: How long does it take to harvest?
items.a: It takes about 10 months from planting to harvest. Then the weather and your care decide the exact day.
The record shows 37 tonnes per hectare on average in the trials. Your own yield depends on the soil, water, fertilizer and pests on your farm.
It is recommended for anywhere in the country. Ask your municipal agriculturist how it has done in your town.

items.q: Where can I buy seed of CG 97 05r 01?
items.a: Ask an accredited seed dealer in your province, the seller named on this page or your municipal agriculturist. Look for the certified seed tag or a sealed pack before you pay.
